paper.title_en: Squeezed quantum states and partner modes in the moving mirror model of black hole evaporation
paper.abstract_en: The standard moving mirror model in (1+1)-dimensional spacetime is known to reproduce several quantum aspects of black hole evaporation. A perfectly reflecting, accelerating mirror can emit radiation whose frequency spectrum resembles that of Hawking radiation, although this correspondence holds only under certain approximations. Moreover, the standard in-out formulation does not provide a natural notion of the partner modes associated with the Hawking radiation. In this paper, we reformulate the moving mirror model in terms of Rindler/Milne modes. This formulation not only attributes the origin of the required approximations to mode squeezing effects but also naturally incorporates the notion of partner modes. Furthermore, as a consequence of these mode squeezing effects, the radiation received by an inertial observer at future null infinity exhibits additional nontrivial quantum correlations, even though its frequency spectrum approximately follows a Bose--Einstein or Fermi--Dirac distribution.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文重新表述了移动镜模型，并为霍金辐射的伙伴模式提供了新视角，深化了对量子关联的理解。
decision.title_zh: 黑洞蒸发的移动镜模型中的压缩量子态与伙伴模式
decision.abstract_zh: 标准的(1+1)维时空中的移动镜模型已知可以重现黑洞蒸发的若干量子方面。一个完全反射的、加速的镜面可以发射频率谱类似于霍金辐射的辐射，尽管这种对应仅在特定近似下成立。此外，标准的in-out表述并未提供与霍金辐射相关的伙伴模式的自然概念。在本文中，我们以Rindler/Milne模式重新表述移动镜模型。这种表述不仅将所需近似的起源归因于模式压缩效应，还自然地包含了伙伴模式的概念。此外，作为这些模式压缩效应的结果，惯性观测者在未来类空无穷远处接收到的辐射表现出额外的非平庸量子关联，即使其频率谱近似遵循玻色-爱因斯坦或费米-狄拉克分布。
